brewing.notes: A safe starting point for green tea: cooler water, short steeps, then adjust by taste.

description:
A bud green tea from Huangcaoping in Xuyong County, Luzhou, Sichuan.

Treat it as you would any green tea: cooler water, short steeps, and a seller who can say where and when it was picked.
name_ru: Сюй Юн Цао Пин Цуй Я
history: Little is documented about it beyond its origin and appearance.
processing: Typical of green tea: picked, heated soon after picking to stop oxidation, then shaped and dried.
harvest_season: Usually picked in spring, with the earliest pickings prized, as with most green teas.
appearance_wet: The buds sink slowly and stand upright at the bottom of the cup.
taste_profile: Fresh and mellow with a sweet finish and a high, fresh aroma.
vintage_note: Green teas like this are normally sold as the current year's harvest and are best within a year of picking. It is not an ageing tea.
